description: This file manages a web worker for executing Python code within a web application, including registering terminal handlers, controlling worker lifecycle, and message handling.

methods.name: getPythonWorker
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton Python worker instance.

methods.name: registerTerminal
methods.description: Registers handlers for messages from the Python worker, including print, input, and reset functions.

methods.name: interruptCodeExecution
methods.description: Attempts to cancel running Python code or resets the worker if cancellation fails.

methods.name: runPythonCode
methods.description: Sends code to the Python worker for execution.

methods.name: sendListenMessage
methods.description: Instructs the worker to listen for new run messages after stopping.
